Title: Create leave with valid JWT returns 201
Steps:
POST /api/v1/leaves
Body: {
  "type": "ANNUAL",
  "startDate": "<tomorrow>",
  "endDate": "<tomorrow+2>",
  "reason": "Trip"
}
1. Send request
2. GET the returned leaveId
Expected Result:
Status 201
Body contains leaveId; GET returns same data with status PENDING

Title: Get existing leave returns 200
Expected Result:
Status 200
Schema: leaveId, type, startDate, endDate, status, reason

Title: Create leave without JWT returns 401
Expected Result:
Status 401
Error body; no record created

Title: Create leave with expired JWT returns 401
Employee cannot read another employee's leave (IDOR)
Preconditions: JWT of Employee A; leave id belongs to Employee B

Title: 31-day request rejected by API
Expected Result:
Status 400
Max 30 days error (server-side validation, not only UI)
